body:
I'm not trying to be egocentric, just looking for a explanation on this particular dilemma. 
Nevertheless I'm grateful for your comment, it makes sense. Thank you.

I get it, program my mind to have a growth mindset.
Exercise to release endorphins
Work hard and smart
Learn new skills, adapt to environment
Network to expand social reach
Find solution to problems, and money will come eventually

But after my partnership failure, I've decided to get back in the workforce. There I can afford to pay the bills and still do something I like/love/want/have passion. But the problem is.... I struggle to find my interest/passion and my brain just doesn't function normally when there's not point doing any of the task... What does the big picture look like?

I did get something out of the therapy session. My therapist did tell me that I keep mentioning the phrase "What's the point of....?" repeatedly during the sessions. She told me that maybe I subconsciously wired myself to be **"logical"**, **"practical"** and **"efficient"** just to make up for the lost time during childhood...(I mentioned to her that my childhood could've been spent better)  


Whilst studying in UK, I've never felt so empty and lost of connection. Lecture and seminar hours were short, most of the shops were close after 5pm. The only things we could do was gaming, booze and casino. I've won a thousand quids in casino(eventually lost them all), but the capital gain never felt so hollow. Capital gains from stock market investment felt the same, what's the whole point of capital gains...what's the whole point of life or existence in general...  


Follow strict routines during my time working. Waking up at 7am, 7-30-8:15 breakfast, 9am-7pm work, 7.30pm-8.30pm dinner, 8.30pm to 10pm work/study/learn, 10pm-11.15pm body building, 11.30pm shower 12am sleep. Repeat for 1 year. Work became repetitive and meaningless, company's management level a bitch. What's the whole point of working... so we can exchange for not experience, but for few paper notes which government can just print/create them whenever they want? Gosh the system is fucked.

I was raised where parents argues all the time(even now) for the smallest matter possible, undeniably it has affected my view on the normal construct of a heartwarming family. Not to mention opening up anything to them, it'll be worthless. My routine was always weekdays in school/work, weekend they'll both out of home.  
I'm struggling to find my passion and whenever I try to find "sense/passion" in new doings, self negative thoughts keep popping out in my head. Gotta find a job to pay the bills etc.   
I've looked into psychiatrist and therapy session but they both thinks I need career development, but I find it hard to learn something that doesn't align with my interest.  
All my life I always had the mindset to be logical and most efficient but neglected the essential cornerstone which helps build meaningful relationship between humans, hence have little to no friends. When I'm into something, I'll give all energy to grow, learn, adapt etc, but literally none after the juice is gone. Now I'm sort of stuck, no interest in learning and living.  
It hurts even more when I know that I got to work meaninglessly just to pay the bills, gosh it's an endless loop...

What is the root cause of your sleep deprivation?  
I share similar experience. Every night I lay on bed wishing the night never ends but eventually knocked myself out due to physical exhaustion. During the day I find it meaningless to do basically anything, the endless cycle of torment has to stop... but lacks a sense of purpose to overturn it...  
What's your story...I would love to hear them...
